Job Title : Assistant Quality Manager for Home Care Powder

Location : Cikarang Factory

About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

Job Purpose

The primary responsibility of the Site Assistant Quality Manager at the factory is to implement Unilever's specifications, standards, and quality management systems to ensure and control product quality starting from material (sourcing), production process, and until finished good meet the specification & standards

Main Responsibilities

• Implement Unilever's Quality Management System for quality assurance and control in the factory, verify compliance with Unilever's Quality Management System and standard
• Implement Unilever’s Quality Management system to assure quality assurance and control toward regulation in Indonesia
• Adhere to and enforce Unilever's Technology Standards and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) guidelines in the factory and continuous improvement in Quality assurance
• Apply control measures, inspections, and sampling plans according to requirements and risks, such as allergens, microbiological contamination, and chemical contamination.
• Conduct necessary tests to verify quality throughout the production process and adhere to Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) guidelines.
• Manage to perform with laboratory team for required tests to check the quality of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished good testing.
• Complete and maintain external certification and audits
• Review and analyze operational KPIs, data, and trends to maintain quality performance within specified ranges.
• Utilize, maintain, and calibrate relevant measurement instruments that relevant to Quality assurance and regulation compliances
• Ensure innovation processes and change management projects in the factory adhere to Unilever's quality standards during the feasibility and execution stages.

Requirements
Experience & Qualification

• University Degree in Engineering or Pharmacy. Supply chain qualifications (e.g., APICS) are an advantage
• Min 3-5 Years in Supply Chain operations (Quality)
• Laboratory compliance & Management experiences
• Quality assurance/engineer experience, SAP capability
• Understanding in statistical and digital will be beneficial

Skill

• Excellent Excel/Presentation skills and Analytical Skills
• Critical thinking, problem solving, and growth mindset
• Good Communication Skills and able to work in fast paced environment and manage timelines
• Strong stakeholder management skill
• Understanding statistical process control and digital will be beneficial

Curious about what it’s really like to work at Unilever? Explore our Life at Unilever : Search our Job Opportunities at Unilever and meet the people shaping our culture.

Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! Thus if you require any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of your application so that we can support you through your recruitment journey.

Job Summary**

PT Agrinusa Jaya Santosa is seeking a dedicated TSR (Technical Sales Representative) Staff for our Animal Health division in Jambi. In this role, you will be responsible for providing technical support to poultry farmers and customers, promoting and selling animal health products, and building strong relationships to drive business growth in the Jambi region.

Job Responsibilities**

* Conduct regular visits to farms and distributors in the Jambi area to provide technical consultations and solutions regarding poultry health and management.
* Promote, market, and sell the company's range of animal health products (vaccines, medicines, and feed additives) to meet regional sales targets.
* Monitor disease outbreaks and animal health trends in the field, providing timely feedback and reports to the management team.
* Organize and conduct technical seminars, product presentations, and educational workshops for local farmers and customers.
* Handle customer complaints with professional technical troubleshooting and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with the commercial and marketing teams to develop effective sales strategies tailored to the Jambi market.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Veterinary Medicine (Dokter Hewan) or Animal Husbandry/Animal Science.
* Minimum of 1–2 years of working experience in the animal health, poultry, or feedmill industry (fresh graduates with strong motivation are welcome to apply).
* Deep understanding of poultry disease management, biosecurity protocols, and animal health products.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Possess a valid driver's license (SIM A and/or SIM C) and willingness to travel extensively within the Jambi region.
* Domiciled in Jambi or willing to be relocated to Jambi.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Monitor inventory levels and ensure accurate stock counts. Coordinate regular inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies.
- Supervise warehouse staff, assign tasks, and ensure team members are trained in warehouse procedures and safety protocols.
- Collaborate with logistics teams to schedule shipments and deliveries, ensuring timely and accurate processing of orders.
- Identify inefficiencies in warehouse operations and implement improvements to enhance productivity and reduce costs.
- Ensure all warehouse activities comply with safety standards and company policies. Conduct regular safety inspections and training sessions.
- Maintain accurate records of warehouse operations, including inventory levels, order statuses, and operational performance metrics.
- Prepare reports for management review.
- Oversee the maintenance and operation of warehouse equipment, ensuring it is in good working condition and complies with safety standards.

- Memantau tingkat inventaris dan memastikan penghitungan stok yang akurat. Mengkoordinasikan audit inventaris secara berkala dan menyelesaikan perbedaan.
- Mengawasi staf gudang, menetapkan tugas, dan memastikan anggota tim dilatih dalam prosedur gudang dan protokol keselamatan.
- Berkolaborasi dengan tim logistik untuk menjadwalkan pengiriman dan pengantaran, memastikan pemrosesan pesanan yang tepat waktu dan akurat.
- Mengidentifikasi ketidakefisienan dalam operasi gudang dan menerapkan perbaikan untuk meningkatkan produktivitas dan mengurangi biaya.
- Memastikan semua aktivitas gudang mematuhi standar keselamatan dan kebijakan perusahaan. Melakukan inspeksi keselamatan secara berkala dan sesi pelatihan.
- Memelihara catatan akurat tentang operasi gudang, termasuk tingkat inventaris, status pesanan, dan metrik kinerja operasional.
- Menyiapkan laporan untuk tinjauan manajemen.
- Mengawasi pemeliharaan dan pengoperasian peralatan gudang, memastikan bahwa peralatan dalam kondisi baik dan mematuhi standar keselamatan.
